title: MZ-065/083/097 integrated Mobile release
request: Release authoritative temporary check-in linkage, guarded OTA restart, and resumable deep-clean feedback together.
outcome: Manual check-ins use explicit server-authoritative linkage, downloaded updates reload only after global safety checks, and feedback submission resumes safely without duplicate business writes.
implementation: MZ-065 queries canonical property/date checkout candidates, requires explicit link or independent choice, invalidates stale responses, and fails closed while preserving conflict input.
MZ-083 blocks reload for unsaved input, persisted drafts, uploads or submissions, rejects stale update targets, prevents duplicate reload clicks, and rechecks safety immediately before native reload.
MZ-097 preserves media identity and owner-scoped drafts, checkpoints successful uploads, uses stable receipt and step identifiers, reports progress truthfully, and makes retries idempotent.
Shared API, Tasks, and Feedback hunks preserve all three contracts without changing roles, task-password rules, or native runtime inputs.
impact_dependencies: MZ-065 requires merged root/CRL-20261103-003 and fails closed when the paired API is unavailable.
MZ-083 changes no manifest, lockfile, native dependency, runtime, channel, or EAS build input.
MZ-097 reuses existing receipt contracts and changes no schema, role, permission, or production data.
validation: Final sanitized focused validation passed TasksScreen and FeedbackFormScreen: 2 suites / 133 tests.
Final exact check:ci passed ledger, typecheck, lint with zero errors, strict button audit, and 84 suites / 826 tests.
Independent review must confirm the exact sanitized candidate; paired Root cloud full regression remains required after Mobile merges to Dev.
Physical devices, native reload, camera/gallery, Chinese IME, and real weak-network behavior remain unverified.
risks: Physical-device restart and media recovery remain unverified; legacy ownerless v1 feedback drafts remain unread and unmigrated.
Future edit or upload surfaces must register restart blockers and persisted-risk scans.
No complete historical ledger change, OTA, EAS build, deployment, runtime override, or production write is included.
